whatIs: CSS Loaders is a collection of more than 600 loading animations made with CSS only, each using a single element, and organized into about 40 categories such as classics, dots or spinners. They all share the same markup, a div with the class loader, and you copy the CSS with one click.
It's a good fit when you need a loading indicator different from the usual spinner and don't want to add JavaScript or a library.
uses: Show an indicator while a page or a component loads.
Put a loader inside a button while a form is being submitted.
Replace a project's generic spinner with one that matches its style.
caveats: Since you copy only the CSS, you have to adjust the color, size and position to fit your design.
They all use the loader class, so if you combine several on one page, rename them so they don't clash.
Each loader is an empty div, with no text for screen readers: add role="status" and an aria-label that announces the loading yourself.
pricingNote: You copy each loader's CSS straight from the site.
idealFor: Anyone who needs a quick loading indicator, without JavaScript.
